proposals.before: As Confucius said: "The Yin revised Xia ritual and the Zhou revised Yin—each tweak can be traced."

proposals.reason: The Chinese says only 故曰 and does not name Confucius; the current version invents an attribution.

proposals.before: He often quoted Confucius: "Lead only with punishments and people stay out of trouble but feel no shame."

proposals.reason: Chinese 常以為 introduces the saying as Liu Kuan's governing principle without naming Confucius; the idiomatic attribution invents a named speaker.
